description_en: Queries the available acceleration regions of a Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用ListAvailableBusiRegions接口查询指定全球加速实例可用的加速地域
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-available-busi-regions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAvailableBusiRegions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID。取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id
